title: Sunshine Golf ☀️⛳ 3D golf game in your browser
author: Slackluster
selftext:
Here's the trailer for my new game, Sunshine Golf. It's a full 3D golf game that runs free in the browser: an 18 hole course, endless procedurally generated remix courses, wind, spin and sloping greens.

It started as a 13 KB entry for the JS13K game jam (13,301 bytes), and then I rebuilt it on my LittleJS engine with the size limit gone.

# How I worked with Claude

I designed and directed the game, playtested it, and gave feedback, and Claude wrote much of the code following my direction. A few things that made that work well:

• A bot that plays full rounds on its own, plus thousands of automated checks, so big changes didn't break the game

• Fast loops: play a build, say what looks or feels wrong, review the fix

• A detailed [CLAUDE.md](http://CLAUDE.md) that records every decision and lesson learned

Claude also built the tool that filmed this trailer. It steps the real game one frame at a time with scripted shots and cameras, so every frame is the actual game running. I gave notes on each draft until it looked right.

# Play it free: [https://killedbyapixel.itch.io/sunshine-golf](https://killedbyapixel.itch.io/sunshine-golf)

# LittleJS: [https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/LittleJS](https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/LittleJS)

Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
